subject: design-technology
title: Research, Ideate, Prototype
welcome_lead: From insight to artefact — the early loops of design.
meta_desc: A-Level D&T: primary research, ideation methods, prototyping.

concepts.def: First-hand data collected by the designer.
Ideation prompts: Substitute, Combine, Adapt, Modify, Put-to-use, Eliminate, Reverse.
Polished model close to final product.

walkthroughs.body_html: Strong primary research: user interviews (n=5-12 reveals most patterns), contextual observation, surveys (n=200+ for statistical confidence), competitor product teardown.
Quantity precedes quality. SCAMPER prompts, worst possible idea, '10 ideas in 10 minutes' generate breadth. Filter only when divergent phase is exhausted.
Match fidelity to question: low-fidelity for concept and flow; medium for usability; high for manufacture and stakeholder buy-in. Save engineering effort for late iterations.
